mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.instance_id AS "instanceId", m.task_id AS "taskId", m.mentioned_by AS "mentionedBy", m.mentioned_by_name AS "mentionedByName", m.comment, m.read_status AS "readStatus", m.read_at AS "readAt", m.created_at AS "createdAt", i.title AS "instanceTitle", i.flow_name AS "flowName", i.flow_status AS "instanceStatus" FROM pmis_flow_mention m LEFT JOIN pmis_flow_instance i ON m.instance_id = i.id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE m.mentioned_user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.read_status = false ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
